text: John Steinbeck's East of Eden was removed from school libraries in Anniston, Alabama, in 1982 after being called “ungodly and obscene,” then reinstated on a restricted basis. In 1991 it was challenged in the Greenville, South Carolina, schools.
meta_description: East of Eden by John Steinbeck: removed from Anniston, Alabama school libraries in 1982, then reinstated with restrictions; challenged in 1991.
